prompt: Voltmarkt splits its order lines into three types. line_type is the text 'bulk' when units is 3 or more, 'big_ticket' when net_revenue_eur is 500.00 or more, and 'regular' for every other line, including lines with a missing value. A line with 3 or more units that is also worth 500.00 or more counts as 'bulk' only. Use the sales table. Return three columns, in this order: line_type, n_lines, the number of order lines, and revenue_eur, the sum of net_revenue_eur. Return one row per line type. A missing net_revenue_eur adds nothing to the sum. Do not round. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the column line_type with its three branches, then the count and the total next to it.
A line can meet both tests, and CASE stops at the first true branch, so the bulk test goes first. Group by the line type so each label becomes one row.
why_this_works: Putting the bulk test first gives a line that meets both tests the label 'bulk', so each line lands in exactly one type before the counts and sums are taken.
